name: com.knowngate/verify
title: KnownGate
description: Food verification for people and AI agents: evidence-backed verdicts, with sources and dates.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.fullDescription: KnownGate is the food verification layer for people and AI agents: it checks food against what must not be in it, or a number it must stay under, and returns evidence-backed verdicts with their sources and read dates.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: Bearer key; a free one is created in-band with the register tool, no signup.
